basic_details.job_title: MANUU Recruitment 2026 - Walkin for Guest Faculty Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU) has officially announced the Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 with 2 openings. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://manuu.edu.in. Candidates holding a Master's degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent) in the relevant subject, along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations, and possessing knowledge of Urdu as required under the University Act, are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 05 August 2026. content_sections.heading: MANUU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the MANUU Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download MANUU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: MANUU Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available – 1 for French and 1 for Russian.

content_sections.heading: MANUU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: French: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in concerned/relevant/allied subject from Indian University or equivalent from foreign university + NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations + Knowledge of Urdu. Russian: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in concerned/relevant/allied subject from Indian University or equivalent from foreign university + NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations + Knowledge of Urdu.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MANUU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MANUU Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The recruitment is based on a walk-in interview, and the interview is scheduled for 05 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in the concerned/relevant/allied subject, along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations. Knowledge of Urdu is also compulsory.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions, with one post each for French and Russian.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the MANUU Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these Guest Faculty roles?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates are required to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU), Hyderabad, Telangana - 500032.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limit for these Guest Faculty positions.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The Guest Faculty positions are on a contractual basis.
